## HF antenna

```{python}
#| label: free-space HF antenna calculation
meter_to_inch = 39.3701 # inches/meter
speed_of_light = 2.997e8 # m/s
freq_Hz = 14_097_020
wavelength_m = speed_of_light/freq_Hz
wavelength_in = wavelength_m * meter_to_inch
velocity_factor = 0.95

antenna_wavelength_m = wavelength_m * velocity_factor
antenna_wavelength_in = antenna_wavelength_m * meter_to_inch

dipole_length_m = antenna_wavelength_m * 0.5
quarter_length_m = antenna_wavelength_m * 0.25
quarter_length_in = quarter_length_m * meter_to_inch

print_row('Frequency',freq_Hz,'Hertz')
print_row('Wavelength free space',wavelength_m,'meter')
print_row('Velocity factor',velocity_factor,)
print_row('Dipole arm length',quarter_length_m,'meter')
print_row('Dipole arm length',quarter_length_in,'inches')

```

Measured antenna on NanoVNA, resonance with arm lengths at 200.25 inches.

```{python}
#| label: computed velocity factor
quarter_length_in = 200.25 # measured arm lengths
quarter_length_m = quarter_length_in / meter_to_inch
dipole_length_m = quarter_length_m * 2
antenna_wavelength_m = dipole_length_m * 2
velocity_factor = antenna_wavelength_m / wavelength_m

print_row('Frequency',freq_Hz,'Hertz')
print_row('Dipole arm length',quarter_length_m,'meter')
print_row('Dipole arm length',quarter_length_in,'inches')
print_row('Velocity factor',velocity_factor,)
```

## Ground test log

### 2026-10-12

Set up on the ground test fixture in live mode (T=0). At 14:12 UTC a partial transmission started and then failed. Likely cause is low sun (insufficient solar power for the transmit); not yet confirmed.

Expected transmit schedule: channel 122 uses the 2-minute slot, so transmissions start on the 2's of every 10-minute cycle (xx:02, :12, :22, :32, :42, :52 UTC). The 14:12 attempt is consistent with that.

With strong sun, all 3 packets of a transmission were received on both the main receiver and the laptop + LimeSDR setup. The main receiver decoded all 3; the laptop + LimeSDR decoded only the first and failed to decode the last two. Cause unknown.

The next set of packets was similar: the laptop + LimeSDR received them but decoded none, while the main receiver received and decoded all of them. The laptop's recordings were saved for analysis.

The antenna used for the laptop recording was later found to be sensitive to QRM when oriented a particular way (noticed while setting up u4b_007). This may have affected decoding here too; see the u4b_007 notes.

## Programs

### Variables

- C is the count of transmissions since wake up
- N is the number of transmissions before switching to high-power (0-based)
- T is a flag for test mode
  - T=1 - test mode
  - T=0 - live mode - must be in live mode for flight
- B is the number of times to blink the led, set to 5
- X is the ERLON - Easting value
- Y is the ERLON - Northing value
- Z is the "big number" for telemetry

### TRACKER2

This is the primary program. The MYTELE and MYGPS subroutines enable control of a test mode which doesn't need GPS or ability to transmit.

```
PRINT "START TRACKER2"
RUN "INIT"
RUN "SHOW"
LET B = 5
RUN "BLINK"
PRINT "INITIAL GPS"
RUN "MYGPS"
LET B = 2
RUN "BLINK"
10 PRINT "LOOP AT #VC"
RUN "SHOW"
RUN "MYTELE"
LET C = C + 1
IF C > N
    LET HP = 1
ENDIF
RUN "MYGPS"
GOTO 10
```

### INIT

Initialization should run once on power up.

This code should be edited for each flight. 
Specifically, set:
- channel number: `CH=xxx`
- test mode: `T=1` for test without GPS/Telemetry OR `T=0` for live

```
PRINT "INIT START"
LET CH = 122
LET HP = 0
LET C = 0
LET N = 2
LET T = 0
LET B = 5
PRINT "HOST USB:    #US"
PRINT "HIGH POWER:  #HP"
PRINT "FREQUENCY:   #FQ"
PRINT "CHANNEL:     #CH"
PRINT "CALLSIGN:    #CS"
PRINT "TEMPERATURE: #TK"
IF T = 1
PRINT "*** TEST MODE ***"
PRINT "FAKE GPS/TELE MODE"
ELSE
PRINT "REAL GPS/TELE MODE"
ENDIF
PRINT "INIT DONE"
```

### SHOW

Prints out the current state

```
PRINT "SHOW START"
PRINT "LLH:  #LT #LN #AT"
PRINT "GPS:  VALID: #GV LOCK: #GL SPEED: #GS CALIB: #CL"
PRINT "GPS:  NSAT:  #SC"
PRINT "CNT:  #VC"
PRINT "TEMP: #TK"
PRINT "POWR: #HP"
PRINT "SHOW DONE"
```

### MYGPS

This is my GPS program, it lets you use the GPS in a test mode without an actual signal. Don't acquire GPS if in test mode (T=1)

```
PRINT "GPS START"
RUN "LEDOFF"
IF T = 0
PRINT "REAL GPS"
GPS 360
ELSE
PRINT "FAKE GPS"
DELAY 2000
ENDIF
RUN "LEDON"
PRINT "GPS END"
```

### MYTELE

Don't transmit if in test mode (T=1)
This packs additional telemetry into the Z variable and sends a 3rd telemetry packet.

THESE URLs create the telemetry packet decode for WSPRtv.com:
https://wsprtv.com/?cs=KF8EEZ&ch=122&band=20m&start_date=2026-06-06&ct_dec=ct,s:2_500:0:1,2:0:1,38:0:1,1000:t100,1000:t101&ct_labels=count,power,nsat&ct_llabels=spot+xmit+since+power,power,number+sats

https://wsprtv.com/tools/ct_wizard.html?spec=https%3A%2F%2Fwsprtv.com%3Fcs%3DKF8EEZ%26ch%3D216%26band%3D20m%26start_date%3D2026-05-17%26ct_dec%3Dct%2Cs%3A2_500%3A0%3A1%2C2%3A0%3A1%2C38%3A0%3A1%2C1000%3At100%2C1000%3At101%26ct_labels%3Dcount%2Cpower%2Cnsat%26ct_llabels%3Dspot%2Bxmit%2Bsince%2Bpower%2Cpower%2Cnumber%2Bsats


```
PRINT "TELEMETRY START"
RUN "LEDOFF"
LET Y = ERLAT 1000
LET X = ERLON 1000
LET Z = 0
LET Z = PACK Z 1000 Y
LET Z = PACK Z 1000 X
LET Z = PACK Z 38 SC
LET Z = PACK Z 2 HP
LET Z = PACK Z 500 C
IF T = 0
PRINT "REAL TELE"
TELE
TELEC Z
ELSE
PRINT "FAKE TELE"
DELAY 2000
ENDIF
RUN "LEDON"
PRINT "TELEMETRY END"
```

### LEDOFF

Turn LED off

```
OUT 19 0
```

### LEDON

Turn LED on

```
OUT 19 1
```

### BLINK

turns led on and off B times. you must set b first

```
FOR L = 0 TO B
RUN "LEDON"
DELAY 100
RUN "LEDOFF"
DELAY 100
NEXT
```
